name: io.github.freedesignstore-online/mcp
description: AI agent tools for FreeDesignStore: browse the CC0 design-asset catalog, apply design playbooks, and create/publish/moderate hosted assets. Read tools are open; write tools require an authenticated creator or admin account.

tools.name: asset_policy
tools.description: Read catalog hosting rules, including Unsplash link-off policy

tools.name: list_design_skills
tools.description: List published FDS design asset playbooks

tools.name: get_design_skill
tools.description: Get one published FDS design asset playbook

tools.name: apply_design_skill
tools.description: Apply a design asset playbook as questions, a checklist, or a tool plan

tools.name: catalog_status
tools.description: Check storage readiness, asset counts, and whether the server is read-only

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated creator profile and public URL

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.description: Update creator handle, bio, website, and social links

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List public or admin-visible pending catalog assets

tools.name: my_assets
tools.description: List assets owned by the authenticated creator account

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Get one asset's metadata and download URL

tools.name: create_svg_asset
tools.description: Create a hosted generated SVG asset under the authenticated account (supports dry_run)

tools.name: create_asset_from_url
tools.description: Ingest a public non-Unsplash HTTPS image URL under the authenticated account (supports dry_run)

tools.name: update_asset
tools.description: Update metadata, taxonomy, and origin disclosure on an owned asset (supports dry_run)

tools.name: moderate_asset
tools.description: Publish or reject a pending asset — admin only (supports dry_run)

tools.name: publish_asset
tools.description: Publish a pending owned asset (supports dry_run)

tools.name: unpublish_asset
tools.description: Move a public owned asset back to pending before deletion (supports dry_run)

tools.name: delete_asset
tools.description: Delete catalog metadata and the R2 object — irreversible, requires confirm=<id> (supports dry_run)

tools.name: mcp_audit_log
tools.description: Read your recent MCP audit events (writes, dry-runs, denials)
